post.description:
Start ingestion for the match's venue: one job per source group that needs data.

A group already being ingested (by anyone, or the schedule) is returned with
``reused_existing_job: true`` instead of starting again. Poll each job with
GET /ingestions/{id}, or poll weather-status. 429 with ``retry_at`` when the only sources
needing data must wait: PAGASA's 4-hour gap (FR-WTH-008) or the cooldown after a failed
attempt (DEC-04).

name.title: Name
name.description: Municipality or province name, as issued.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: PAGASA's own wording, e.g. affecting, watch.

last_error_code.title: Last Error Code
last_error_code.description: Set when the latest attempt failed.

AlertsStatus.title: AlertsStatus
AlertsStatus.description:
Freshness of the nationwide PAGASA alerts check (DEC-04: current while checked < 1 h
ago). Alerts refresh on their own (schedule, and on open via GET .../alerts); they never
make ``ingestion_needed`` true.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when no source has a value for this hour.

state.description: `current`, or `stale` when no current source had a value (show as stale).

fallback_label.title: Fallback Label
fallback_label.description: Set when a lower-priority source was used, e.g. 'Rain: PAGASA ECMWF; PAGASA ATMO stale'.

range.description: Only for comparable quantities with 2+ current sources. For directions: the smallest clockwise arc from `min` to `max`.

attributions.title: Attributions
attributions.description: Must be shown wherever this data appears (Open-Meteo licence).

ConsolidatedWeather.title: ConsolidatedWeather
ConsolidatedWeather.description:
Best source per value with labelled fallback and a range across sources (P-09).
Never averaged across sources. Per-source states and provenance: `sources`.

assessment_id.title: Assessment Id
assessment_id.description: Assessment the answer explains, if any.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: AI-generated explanation. Not an official decision.

ConversationRole.title: ConversationRole
ConversationRole.description: Conversational context only, not an authenticated account role (P-03).

CoverageWindow.title: CoverageWindow
CoverageWindow.description: Forecasts must cover this window to count (DEC-04: kickoff to kickoff + 2 h).

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable summary. Never contains internal details.

retry_at.title: Retry At
retry_at.description: When a RATE_LIMITED request may be retried (UTC). Also sent as Retry-After.

field.title: Field
field.description: Dotted location of the invalid input.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Great-circle distance from the venue, computed by Pitchy.

authority.title: Authority
authority.description: Issuing body, e.g. the football authority.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version or date of the approved document.

GuidanceReference.title: GuidanceReference
GuidanceReference.description: Reference to an approved protocol document (RAG knowledge base).

Hazard.title: Hazard
Hazard.description: Hazards the engine assesses (P-04). Alerts and cyclone signals are official info, below.

indicator_value.title: Indicator Value
indicator_value.description: Calculated indicator, e.g. WBGT, if any.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Set only by approved deterministic rules.

message.title: Message
message.description: Safe summary. Never contains secrets or raw responses.

reused_existing_job.title: Reused Existing Job
reused_existing_job.description: True when another request or the schedule already started this job (FR-WTH-004). Always false on GET /ingestions/{id}.

IngestionJob.title: IngestionJob
IngestionJob.description: One source group at one venue (e.g. PAGASA ATMO + ECMWF). Holds that scope's lock.

IngestionRequestResult.title: IngestionRequestResult
IngestionRequestResult.description: Answer to a manual Ingest: one job per source group that needed data.

parameter.title: Parameter
parameter.description: Parameter code. The list is OPEN (DEC-03).

InputValue.title: InputValue
InputValue.description: A weather value the engine used, with its provenance (FR-CLI-004).

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Where the level comes from (AFC 30 s ≈ 10 km, Pitchy's conversion).

LightningLevel.title: LightningLevel
LightningLevel.description: Approved distance level for the nearest flash (team decision 2026-11-23).

state.description: current while the last check is under 5 minutes old; stale after that.

last_error_code.title: Last Error Code
last_error_code.description: Set when the latest attempt failed.

Limitation.title: Limitation
Limitation.description: A data or method limitation the client must show (FR-SAF-004, FR-AGT-005).

kickoff_at.title: Kickoff At
kickoff_at.description: Match start, ISO 8601 with UTC offset.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: A `scope_key` from GET /venues. Unknown keys are rejected (422).

pitch_surface.title: Pitch Surface
pitch_surface.description: Optional pitch metadata. Allowed values are not decided (P-07).

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Plain text. Never render as HTML.

message.title: Message
message.description: Plain text. Never render as HTML.

matched_areas.title: Matched Areas
matched_areas.description: The areas that include this venue.

source.title: Source
examples: AFC Competition Operations Manual, Edition 2026, art. 8.3

OfficialGuidance.title: OfficialGuidance
OfficialGuidance.description: Official procedure, shown as issued. Officials decide on site (AFC art. 8.3).

OfficialNotice.title: OfficialNotice
OfficialNotice.description: Official alert or cyclone signal, shown as issued; never turned into a classification.

source_issued_at.title: Source Issued At
source_issued_at.description: Model run time, when the source reports it (PAGASA `init`).

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where and when a value came from (FR-WTH-005). Fields are null when a source omits them.

token.title: Token
token.description: Opaque, server-signed. Never log or display it.

covers_match_time.title: Covers Match Time
covers_match_time.description: True when stored forecasts cover the whole coverage window without a gap.

current_until.title: Current Until
current_until.description: When the data used stops being current (DEC-04). Null when nothing is used.

provenance.description: The fetch whose data is used; its valid times are those covering the match. Null when nothing covers the match.

ValueRangeOut.title: ValueRangeOut
ValueRangeOut.description: Spread across current, comparable sources. Not an agreement label (no tolerances yet).

active_tropical_cyclones.title: Active Tropical Cyclones
active_tropical_cyclones.description: Count from PAGASA's cyclone track at the last successful check.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Alerts covering this venue and not past valid_until.

label.title: Label
label.default: Official PAGASA information, shown as issued. Not a Pitchy classification.

scope_key.title: Scope Key
scope_key.description: Stable venue key. Send it as `venue` when creating a match context.

live_window.description: Live checks happen only in this window (before kickoff to match end).

detection_minutes.title: Detection Minutes
detection_minutes.description: Each check covers this many minutes back.

flash_count.title: Flash Count
flash_count.description: Flashes in the last successful check; null if none yet.

flashes.title: Flashes
flashes.description: Nearest first, from the last successful check.

level.description: Set only when a current check found lightning inside an approved distance level. Null otherwise; null never means safe.

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain-language reminder of what the data is and is not; always show it.

ingestion_needed.title: Ingestion Needed
ingestion_needed.description: Any enabled source stale, missing or unavailable and not updating (DEC-04). The client shows Ingest only when this is true.

active_job_ids.title: Active Job Ids
active_job_ids.description: Ingestion jobs running for this venue now; poll GET /ingestions/{id}.

next_ingestion_at.title: Next Ingestion At
next_ingestion_at.description: Set when a source needing data must wait: PAGASA's 4-hour gap (FR-WTH-008) or the cooldown after a failed attempt (DEC-04). Ingest before then cannot refresh it.
